## Remarks

This is the base method for all media reply methods. Use specific methods like [Ctx.replyPhoto()](./gramstax.ctx.replyphoto.md) or [Ctx.replyVideo()](./gramstax.ctx.replyvideo.md) for simpler usage.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  await this.replyMedia("photo")
}
```
